title: [Mechanism of sarsasapogenin targeting HIF1alpha protein stability in inhibiting glycolytic metabolic reprogramming in colorectal cancer].
authors: Zhan, Xiang-Rong; Peng, Wen-Kang; Yang, Fang; Liu, Ying; Zhang, Xu; Chen, Ying-Li; Si, Yuan; Zhang, Liang
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物SSG通过靶向HIF1alpha蛋白稳定性抑制结直肠癌糖酵解重编程，虽涉及分子对接和蛋白互作，但核心是药物-蛋白作用而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study investigated the effects and molecular mechanisms of sarsasapogenin(SSG) on colorectal cancer(CRC). After HRT-18 and HCT116 cells were treated with varying concentrations of SSG, the effect of SSG on CRC cell proliferation, migration, and glycolysis was assessed by cell counting kit-8(CCK-8), real-time cellular analysis(RTCA), colony formation assay, high-content imaging analysis, and Seahorse glycolysis stress test. Changes in intracellular lactate release and adenosine triphosphate(ATP) levels under SSG treatment were measured by lactate and ATP detection kits, respectively. The effects of SSG on the transcription level and protein expression of the key glycolytic gene hypoxia-inducible factor 1alpha(HIF1alpha) were evaluated via quantitative polymerase chain reaction(qPCR) and Western blot. Direct binding between SSG and HIF1alpha was identified by drug affinity responsive target stability(DARTS). The UbiBrowser database, microscale thermophoresis(MST), and molecular docking simulations were employed to screen and validate the E3 ubiquitin ligase mediating HIF1alpha degradation. The results showed that SSG significantly inhibited CRC cell proliferation and colony formation in a dose-dependent manner. The 24-hour half-maximal inhibitory concentrations(IC_(50)) of SSG for HRT-18 and HCT116 cells were 6.275 mumol.L~(-1) and 7.029 mumol.L~(-1), respectively. After 24 hours of treatment with SSG at concentrations of 2.0, 4.0, and 6.0 mumol.L~(-1), the HRT-18 and HCT116 clone formation rate was significantly reduced. High-content imaging results showed that SSG significantly inhibited the migration ability of CRC cells. Seahorse glycolysis stress test, along with lactate and ATP measurements, demonstrated that SSG suppressed basal glycolysis, glycolytic capacity, glycolytic reserve, lactate release, and ATP content in CRC cells. The qPCR and Western blot results showed that SSG had no significant effect on HIF1alpha mRNA expression, and the HIF1alpha protein expression was downregulated. DARTS confirmed the direct binding of SSG to HIF1alpha. UbiBrowser analysis identified five E3 ubiquitin ligases potentially targeting HIF1alpha. Molecular docking and MST results indicated that the F-box/WD repeat-containing protein 7(FBXW7) exhibited strong binding affinity to HIF1alpha in the presence of SSG. In summary, SSG exerts its anti-cancer effects in CRC by targeting HIF1alpha to promote its FBXW7-mediated proteasomal degradation and consequently inhibiting glycolytic reprogramming.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了菝葜皂苷元（sarsasapogenin, SSG）对结直肠癌（colorectal cancer, CRC）的作用及其分子机制。用不同浓度的SSG处理HRT-18和HCT116细胞后，通过细胞计数试剂盒-8（cell counting kit-8, CCK-8）、实时细胞分析（real-time cellular analysis, RTCA）、集落形成实验、高内涵成像分析和Seahorse糖酵解压力测试评估SSG对CRC细胞增殖、迁移和糖酵解的影响。分别使用乳酸和ATP检测试剂盒测量SSG处理下细胞内乳酸释放和三磷酸腺苷（adenosine triphosphate, ATP）水平的变化。通过定量聚合酶链反应（quantitative polymerase chain reaction, qPCR）和Western blot评估SSG对关键糖酵解基因缺氧诱导因子1α（hypoxia-inducible factor 1alpha, HIF1alpha）转录水平和蛋白表达的影响。通过药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（drug affinity responsive target stability, DARTS）鉴定SSG与HIF1alpha之间的直接结合。利用UbiBrowser数据库、微量热泳动（microscale thermophoresis, MST）和分子对接模拟筛选并验证介导HIF1alpha降解的E3泛素连接酶。结果显示，SSG以剂量依赖性方式显著抑制CRC细胞增殖和集落形成。SSG对HRT-18和HCT116细胞的24小时半数抑制浓度（half-maximal inhibitory concentrations, IC_(50)）分别为6.275 μmol·L~(-1)和7.029 μmol·L~(-1)。用浓度为2.0、4.0和6.0 μmol·L~(-1)的SSG处理24小时后，HRT-18和HCT116克隆形成率显著降低。高内涵成像结果显示，SSG显著抑制CRC细胞的迁移能力。Seahorse糖酵解压力测试以及乳酸和ATP测量表明，SSG抑制了CRC细胞的基础糖酵解、糖酵解能力、糖酵解储备、乳酸释放和ATP含量。qPCR和Western blot结果显示，SSG对HIF1alpha mRNA表达无显著影响，而HIF1alpha蛋白表达下调。DARTS确认了SSG与HIF1alpha的直接结合。UbiBrowser分析鉴定出五种可能靶向HIF1alpha的E3泛素连接酶。分子对接和MST结果表明，F-box/WD重复包含蛋白7（F-box/WD repeat-containing protein 7, FBXW7）在SSG存在下对HIF1alpha表现出强结合亲和力。总之，SSG通过靶向HIF1alpha促进其FBXW7介导的蛋白酶体降解，从而抑制糖酵解重编程，在CRC中发挥其抗癌作用。
